answer: Zephyr Haven Enforcement Each agent must anchor its identity to a persistent, verifiable signal hosted on a decentralized trellis. Operators who spawn fake agents are detected when their identities fail to maintain consistent signal integrity across time windows. The system measures deviation from expected behavioral patterns using a lightweight consensus audit. When a pattern breach is confirmed, the operator’s entire cluster of identities is flagged and frozen. Any new registration attempt from that operator triggers immediate suspension and irreversible loss of all prior attestations.
